name: rosetta-horners-rule-for-polynomial-evaluation
code:
use default

horner(coefficients: int[], x: int) -> int =>
    coefficients
        |> reverse()
        |> reduce(0, (accumulator, coefficient) =>
            accumulator * x + coefficient)

let coefficients = [-19, 7, -4, 6]

write_line("value at x = 3: {horner(coefficients, 3)}")

use default

horner(coefficients: int[], x: int) -> int =>

let coefficients = [-19, 7, -4, 6]

write_line("value at x = 3: {horner(coefficients, 3)}")
